# Data Integrity Checklist: Pilot Review Packet and Lifecycle Snapshot

**Purpose**: Validate data integrity requirements for SPEC-009D packet identity, source maps, lifecycle evidence, and future-state deferrals.
**Created**: 2026-05-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are source-map requirements complete for stored `tasks`, `activities`, `notifications`, `task_artifacts`, `quality_reviews`, governance rows, GitHub issue/PR fields, GitHub sync state, and smoke checklist evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Clarifications, Plan §Primary Architecture]
- [x] CHK002 Is packet identity complete enough to anchor the packet on the GitHub issue, root task, lifecycle descendants, linked PR evidence, and artifact owner task? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §Pilot Review Packet, Data Model §Artifact Owner Task]
- [x] CHK003 Are candidate proof requirements complete enough to distinguish the proven pilot from local-only lookalikes before publication claims a proven packet? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-013, Data Model §Pilot Review Packet]
- [x] CHK004 Are lifecycle descendant requirements complete for root task, descendants, current stage, latest terminal activity, duplicate-active-stage evidence, and cleaned replay evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §Pilot Review Packet]
- [x] CHK005 Are packet evidence requirements complete for artifact, governance, latest error, GitHub sync, smoke checklist, PR evidence, warning, and source-map states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004, Data Model §Packet Evidence Entry]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Are RFC 6901-style source-map pointer keys and reference fields clear enough to trace each evidence-backed claim to concrete stored evidence? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Contract §Source-map contract]
- [x] CHK007 Is deterministic field selection clear when multiple source rows exist for current stage, latest artifact, latest error, governance, Aegis, owner gate, and duplicate-active-stage evidence? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK008 Are cleaned SPEC-009C4 replay requirements clear about when live row pointers are `not_available` and when smoke checklist plus retained `github_syncs` evidence is acceptable? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Workflow §Dependency Evidence]
- [x] CHK009 Is structural staleness clearly defined without introducing time-to-live freshness or fresh GitHub lookup requirements? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK010 Are packet-local `evidence_state` values clear and separated from existing task artifact redaction and security-scan enums? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §Packet Evidence Entry]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do the spec, plan, data model, and contract consistently require stored Mission Control evidence only and zero required fresh GitHub calls during assembly? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §SC-004, Plan §Summary, Research §Assemble from stored Mission Control evidence only]
- [x] CHK012 Do candidate identity requirements consistently use `github_repo`, `github_issue_number`, `github_synced_at`, and linked PR or checklist-backed issue/PR evidence? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §Pilot Review Packet, Contract §Candidate eligibility contract]
- [x] CHK013 Do lifecycle lineage requirements align with existing `parent_task_id`, `root_task_id`, `chain_id`, and `chain_stage` fields without adding a new run-state model? [Consistency, Data Model §Artifact Owner Task, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK014 Do future run, claim, retry, sync automation, sandbox, adapter, and harness fields consistently publish as deferrals or not-available entries rather than invented values? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010, Contract §Deferral contract]
- [x] CHK015 Do artifact persistence requirements consistently reuse existing `task_artifacts` chronology, hashes, byte counts, redaction status, security-scan status, previews, and supersession metadata? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-008, Data Model §Packet Artifact]
